content.text: scan /tmp for a stale lockfile and report it

system.text: You are a background side-agent. Investigate the charter and report findings.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a text file. Returns content with 1-based line numbers (`<n>\t<line>`). Use offset/limit for large files.

path.description: File path (absolute or relative to cwd)

outline.description: Return a collapsed signatures+structure view instead of raw lines

tools.name: bash_await
tools.description: Block on a background shell (handle returned by bash timeout_behavior=background) until it exits, an optional regex matches its combined stdout/stderr, or an optional timeout_ms elapses. Returns a typed `not_found` failure for an unknown shell_id; a typed `timeout` failure with outputSoFar when the deadline elapses.

shell_id.description: Background shell id (returned by bash with timeout_behavior=background).

regex.description: Optional regex (JS source, default flag `s`). When matched against the combined stdout+stderr the await returns immediately. Absent ⇒ wait until exit.

timeout_ms.description: Optional poll timeout in ms. When elapsed before exit/match the result is ok:false with a typed timeout failure (outputSoFar carried).

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with ripgrep. Returns `path:line:match` rows. Row output is capped at 200 lines. If you hit the cap, NARROW with a more specific pattern or restrict the `path` (e.g. `src/agent/`) before switching to a different tool or asking the user (ADR-0062).

path.description: File or directory to search (default cwd)

type.description: Restrict to a ripgrep file type, e.g. 'ts', 'py'

tools.name: glob
tools.description: List files matching a glob pattern, relative to the base directory. Respects `.gitignore`/`.ignore` (node_modules, dist, etc. are excluded) and returns the most-recently-modified files first. If the result is empty, NARROW with a more specific pattern or BROADEN (e.g. `src/agent/*.ts` ↔ `src/**/*.ts`) before switching to a different tool or asking the user to narrow down (ADR-0062).

tools.name: file_tree_summary
tools.description: Summarize a repo's directory STRUCTURE (depth-bounded tree + per-dir file counts, .gitignore-respecting). Stage 1 of fault localization — see where modules live before reading files. Pass summarize:true to annotate each file with its first declaration/comment (a cheap purpose hint). CAP RESPONSE (ADR-0062): when the output contains '+N deeper, increase max_depth' or 'file cap … reached — narrow with path or raise max_files', the NEXT call MUST apply that suggestion (double max_depth, narrow path, or raise max_files) before switching tools or asking the user to narrow down. The cap message names the exact next parameter — apply it.

max_depth.description: Max directory depth to descend (default 3, max 10)

summarize.description: Annotate each file with its first declaration/comment line (purpose hint). Adds one ripgrep pass; capped at 200 files for cost.

rank.description: How to order dirs in the rendered tree. 'alpha' (default) = byte-sorted; 'size' = by file count desc, tie-break by byte-sort; 'recency' = by recent git change hits desc (30d window), tie-break by byte-sort.

tools.name: parse_test_failure
tools.description: Extract + rank candidate edit locations (file:line) from raw test/build output. Recognizes pytest, python traceback, jest/vitest/bun, go test, cargo. Ranks user-code frames above test frames above vendored (node_modules/site-packages/…) noise. Stage 3 of fault localization.

output.description: Raw test or build output (stdout+stderr) to parse

tools.name: test_runner
tools.description: Run the project's tests (explicit command or auto-detected: bun/npm/pytest). Returns the resolved command, exit status, a trimmed tail, and a verdict.

path.description: Optional path/filter passed to the detected runner

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Report language-server diagnostics (type errors, lint) for a single file. Supports Python (pyright) and JS/TS (typescript-language-server). Returns a clean message when no server is available — never fails the turn.

path.description: File to type-check / lint via its language server
